# Entity ID fixtures

`entity-ids-typescript.json` contains the proof of concept's [recorded UUID vectors](https://github.com/hashintel/labs/blob/40a8d14535cee4020c2cd24c7e513bc209b59e19/pocs/integrations_rs/tests/golden/uuids.json). The two numeric source IDs are stored as text to match the derivation function's input.

`web-fixture` is replaced with a valid web UUID when testing composite entity IDs.
